scope: Primary-source evidence ledger. Published capability is separated from our contest inference; no engine source or published network is incorporated.

sources.title: AI Chessathon rules and agent contract
sources.supports: Runtime, original-model and training-data permissions; source/engine restrictions
sources.evidence: Full public Markdown retained under public/, fetch hashes in public/fetches.json

sources.title: AI Chessathon leaderboard and AlphaFish games36-39
sources.supports: Leader record and observed timing, not architecture

sources.title: Amortized Planning with Large-Scale Transformers: A Case Study on Chess
sources.supports: Data/model/target scaling; action-value advantage affected by data count; large searchless capability is not CPU deployment evidence
sources.limitation: Published strongest model and training scale far exceed this pilot

sources.title: ChessBench dataset documentation
sources.supports: Public labelled-data availability and CC-BY/CC0 attribution
sources.limitation: Only training data slices acquired; no pretrained weights or engine implementations

sources.title: Bagz and tuple serialization references
sources.supports: Offset table, nested UTF8 and big-endian double format
sources.limitation: Original bounded reader implements the format; data tooling is not engine code

sources.title: Giraffe: Using Deep Reinforcement Learning to Play Chess
sources.supports: Joint learned evaluation/probability-limited search; policy invocation cost changes benefits
sources.limitation: Historical baselines, no Tempest or contest comparison

sources.title: Enhancing Chess Reinforcement Learning with Graph Representation
sources.supports: Graph relational inductive bias and initial learning advantage
sources.limitation: MultipleGPU training, single-seed configurations; no tenfold CPU inference claim

sources.title: Best-first minimax search
sources.supports: Pure best-first depth limitations and hybrid AB/best-first experiment

sources.supports: Learning from backed-up internal search states

sources.title: Selecting Computations: Theory and Applications
sources.authors: Nicholas Hay; Stuart Russell; David Tolpin; Solomon Shimony
sources.supports: Value-of-computation selection and myopic stopping limitations
